scripts.vercel-build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp index.html styles.css script.js dist/ && cp -R assets content dist/
scripts.check:content: node --input-type=module -e "import('./content/site-content.js').then(({ siteContent }) => { const expected = ['Salon', 'Tee & Genuss', 'Veranstaltungen', 'Maria', 'Geschenkbox', 'Besuch']; const valid = siteContent.navigation.map(({ label }) => label).join('|') === expected.join('|') && siteContent.locale.available.length === 1 && siteContent.productWorld.length === 4 && siteContent.events.length >= 6 && typeof siteContent.teaOfTheDay.active === 'boolean'; if (!valid) process.exit(1); })"
scripts.typecheck: node --check script.js && node --check content/site-content.js && node --check tools/check-styles.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run check:content && npm run check:styles
scripts.test: npm run check:content && npm run check:styles
